name: log-lens
description: Live log viewer: tails log files and streams them to a browser with an instant client-side filter language.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run test:watch -w server" "npm run test:watch -w client"
